segments.source: Obusumi bwaira muno, Entale ekaba niyo yamaani kandi netinwa mubisoro byona.
Baitu nyenkya emu obu ekaba neserra ekyanyenkya ekakwatirwa mumutego.
Entale ekajwaha kandi yahurra obusalizi bwingi.
Ebiro bikarabaho obu entale nikara mumusana.
Ekaba ine enja ra niroho hakaba hataroho nomu owokugijuna.
Entale ekahoibwamu kunihira obu ebiro nibirabaho.
"Ningenda kwitwa enjara niroho mumutego," yatekereza yonka.
Nyenkya emu, Entale ekahurra iraka niriruga mwirungu.
Ekarora egiri nerubata namukazi wayo nabaana, nibibaza kandi nibiseka.
Abeka yengiri bakaba nibagenda hakisaaru kunywa amaizi nokuzaanira mubisaabu.
Turaba banywani obu orantegurra," Entale yagamba."
"Tikwenda kukurora mubusaasi nkobu, iroho nenjara kukwita."
Nahabweki yasika omutego namani yategurra entale.
Entale yagamba, "Webale muno munywani wange kujuna obwomezi bwange."
Entale yarubata nesenjura etaina namaani nerumwa nenjara.
Aho yarora abaana bangiri nibazanira mubisabu.
"Kiro kinu kyomugisa," Entale yangamba nejwa ebirusu.
Caali orankonyera ompeho omwana wawe omu owekyanyenkya?"
"Nkakujuna mumutego hati nogonza kulya abaana bange?
Entale yagamba, "Anganyire munyani wange, nindumwa enjara baitu ninkukira ntale yayesamya."
Akanwa kayo yayoleka amaino gaayo agakyenju.
"Obwotampeho omwana omu ninyija kumwekwatira," Ntale yagamba.
Engiri yamanya tiine enziriga rundi amaani nkentale.
Entale yagamba kale ninyija kukuha omwana wange.
Baitu obanze onyoleke nkoku okaba okwasirwe omuntego obundi ndyongere ntengurre entale endi.
Entale yabarabaramu obunuzi bw' ekyana kyengiri mukanwake.
Entale yagaruka mumutego kwoleka munywani wayo nkoko yakwasirwe.
Iruka!" mukyara wegiri yatoka nagambira abaanabe.
Mwimukye emikira yanyu obu muraaba nimwiruka nukwo Isinywe abarole.
Entale yayesengereza nobusaasi bwigimumutego Ninyija kukukorra enkintukyo na obworanjuna''Busaho mulingo gwona, todyongera kukwikiriri zaamu Ninyija kugambira ebisoro ebindi bitakujunaga.
Engiri yarora abaana baayo nibairuka murukarra nanyinabo emikira yabo eri haiguru nukwo abirole.
